intent: Written small-change plans repair singular be and adjective use, accept by-doing or will-do action structures and keep present untidiness separate from permanent labels.
picturePurpose: Coded sentence contrasts show the grammatical relationships directly; the separate spoken lesson already uses a purposeful bag scene.

workshop.title: 把现状与小改变写通顺
workshop.instruction: 先改一句现状描述，再比较两种行动句，最后检查有没有把今天写成永远。用自己的两到四个完整句子回应任务。

items.label: 先把今天的状态写对
items.prompt: My bag作主语，怎样写“今天书包很乱”？
items.reason: 主谓和untidy的用法已核对。再写出自己的现状描述，不用永久标签代替事实。
items.hint: bag在这里是单数，用is；untidy描述书包的状态，untidily通常修饰动作。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。你的书包很乱，但不想给自己贴“永远不会整理”的标签。说明一个今天能做的小改变。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 现状句检查卡
composeBrief.hint: 比较主语与be，再看状态词。
composeBrief.wrong: My bag后不能用are；这里需要形容词untidy，不是副词untidily。

fields.label: 哪句通顺且保留今天这个范围？

items.label: 两种行动句，都能说明一个小改变
items.prompt: 选一种示例句式，再接上匹配的行动句。
items.reason: 所选句式与动词形式已匹配。自己的可行整理动作可以不同，不必都选参考稿的做法。
items.hint: begin by后常接doing；will后接动词原形。两种都可用来写计划，不强迫只用较长的参考句。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。你的书包很乱，但不想给自己贴“永远不会整理”的标签。说明一个今天能做的小改变。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 行动句式对照卡
composeBrief.hint: 先选择句式，再核对动词形式；示例动作不是唯一答案。
composeBrief.wrong: begin by putting和will put都可以；不能机械混搭成begin by put。

choices.label: I can begin by putting tomorrow’s materials in one pocket today.
I will put tomorrow’s materials in one pocket today.
I can begin by put tomorrow’s materials in one pocket today.

items.label: 只写今天，不给自己下永久结论
items.prompt: 写完后，怎样检查事实范围与任务形式？
items.reason: 今天的状态、一个小行动与完整句子已核对。再检查自己的两到四句是否都回应了任务。
items.hint: 整理资料、收好散笔等都可作为小改变；本题不要求列出所有问题或保证以后永远完美。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。你的书包很乱，但不想给自己贴“永远不会整理”的标签。说明一个今天能做的小改变。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 范围与成稿检查卡
composeBrief.hint: 描述真实现状，再说明今天能开始的动作。
composeBrief.wrong: 别否认今天杂乱，也别扩大成永久评价；成稿要用2—4句完整英文说明现状和今天能开始的具体行动，只写笔记或漏掉行动都不够。

fields.label: 哪句把事实范围说得准确？

choices.label: My untidy bag shows that I cannot learn to organise my things.
My bag is untidy today, but I can make a small change.
My bag is already perfectly tidy, so there is nothing to change.
Write a plan as short notes, such as bag untidy today; papers in one pocket.
Write two to four complete sentences about the current state and one feasible change.
Describe today’s untidiness in full sentences, leaving out the action to start today.

transfer.stem: Which written plan fits the new task and uses clear sentence forms?
transfer.passage:
A different organising plan
Your locker is untidy today. Write two to four complete English sentences describing its current state without labelling yourself as someone who can never organise things. Explain one feasible locker-organising action you can start today. For example, you could put tomorrow’s workbooks together on one shelf; another relevant action is also allowed. Do not deny the given untidiness or promise permanent perfection.

options.text: My bag is untidy today, but I can make a small change. I will put tomorrow’s materials in its front pocket today. This will help me find them more easily.
My locker are untidy today, but I can make a small change. I can begin by put tomorrow’s workbooks together on one shelf. This will help me find them more easily.
My locker is untidy today, but I can make a small change. I will put tomorrow’s workbooks together on one shelf today. This will help me find them more easily.
My locker is untidy today, but I can make a small change. I will try to keep it tidier from now on. I hope that my locker will become easier to use.

answer.display: My locker is untidy today, but I can make a small change. I will put tomorrow’s workbooks together on one shelf today. This will help me find them more easily.

explanation.strategy: 先更新对象，再检查现状范围和行动句的动词形式。

steps.text: 这次是今天柜子很乱，不能仍写旧题的书包，也不能推出永远不会整理。
steps.reason: 给定事实要保留，评价范围不能扩大。

steps.text: 提出一个今天可开始的动作，用正确完整的句子写成两到四句。
steps.reason: begin by doing或will do都可用，关键是形式与意思通顺，行动具体。

distractors.reason: 没有把旧书包情境更新为柜子和相应动作。
单数locker应配is；begin by后不能直接用put。
承认了今天杂乱，但try to keep it tidier和希望更好用都没有说明今天要开始的具体动作。

explanation.pitfall: 句子看似完整，却没有更新新题对象，或把具体行动写成笼统的愿望。

visual.title: 状态句与行动句分开检查
visual.caption: 写法可以不同，现状和一个可行动作都要清楚。

explanation.transfer: 如果把I will collect the pencils改成I can begin by…，collect要怎样变？
